narrative.overview: Warm, daylight-readable ivory surfaces and deep olive navigation draw from Italian atelier stationery. Matte brass gives small cues of structure and focus.
dos: Keep formal Thai, readable field sizes and bottom safe areas.
Pair every material or disposal color with words.
donts: Do not turn confidence into a claim of actual per-image accuracy.
Do not add ornamental luxury effects that obscure controls or evidence.
